text:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — starting a POC with Quantique Health. Requirement: sustained 600 qps for 2h, 512-token outputs, target p99 < 200ms. They also want a cost estimate for steady-state + burst and confirmation we can meet SOC/Sec questionnaire items. Can eng + solutions help scope a load plan and quick pricing? :raised_hands:
Anya (SE): noted. I can run a smoke run tomorrow, will need the exact prompt length distribution and % streaming requests vs batched. Any synthetic trace we should mimic?
Priya (SWE): suggested load plan: warmup 15m, ramp to 600 qps over 10m, 2h steady, 10m cool-down. Use Poisson arrivals to simulate real traffic + 5% microbursts (x3 for 30s) to test tail. Run across model variants: rwd-7b-q8, rwd-13b-q4 and rwd-13b-8k to compare latency/cost. Enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts.
Priya (SWE): example load command we used last time:
```
rwd-load --model rwd-13b-q4 --target-qps 600 --duration 7200 --ramp 600 --warmup 900 --burst-profile "5%:30s@3x" --concurrency 80 --payload-dist prompts.json
```
Devon (SRE): infra notes: recommend Dedicated pool sized to handle 750 qps headroom for bursts, enable autoscale with 2-min cooldown. Multi-AZ for resiliency; enable fallback policy to rwd-7b-q8 if GPUS saturated. Ensure KV cache warmup during ramp so p99 isn't dominated by cold KV misses.
Marta (Solutions): pricing stub: assuming rwd-13b-q4 on dedicated capacity with our typical batch settings, estimate ~ $1,200/hr for the pool to sustain 600 qps (ballpark). For the 2h run + warmup/cooldown expect ~ $2.8k. If they want hosted usage instead, token-based estimate ~ $0.22 per 1k-inferred-tokens (rough), will refine after exact token counts.
Priya (SWE): quick config tweak: reduce max_batch_delay to 6ms for latency-sensitive routes; increases GPU ops but drops p99. Also keep streaming on for first token flush.
load-bot: load summary (from quick internal run):
```json
{"test":"quantique-smoke-2026-03-20","sustained_qps":610,"p50_ms":42,"p95_ms":115,"p99_ms":208,"error_rate_pct":0.6,"cpu_gpu_util_pct":81,"notes":"p99 slightly above 200ms; try larger pool or smaller model/looser batch_delay"}
```
Sam (AE): thanks — p99 208ms is close but above their 200ms SLO. Options: increase pool size, drop to rwd-7b-q8 (cost win), or tune batch_delay. Which is fastest to try before customer run?
Devon (SRE): fastest: spin +20% capacity on Dedicated and rerun the short 30m steady. Then test lowering batch_delay to 6ms if still high. I can schedule a hotpath test today if Priya can push the config.
Priya (SWE): can do. I'll push config and run a 30m validation at 600 qps in ~2h. Will post results.
Marta (Solutions): I'll update the pricing sheet with both options (bigger pool vs smaller model) and a per-hour delta. Also pulling the security questionnaire answers for Quantique — will share a redacted copy.
Sam (AE): perfect. Customer acceptance criteria: sustained 600 qps, p99 <200ms, <1% errors for 2h. If we can meet that on the validation run, I'll schedule the customer demo. Thanks team! :rocket:
